info.name: Library REST API
info.description:
REST API for the library (rest/). Start it first: cd rest, npm install, npm start (Node 22.13+).

Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner and keep the folder order.
Folder 4 creates a publisher, an author, and a book and stores their ids in the collection variables publisherId, authorId, and bookId; later folders use them.
Errors are { "error": "message" } with status 400 (invalid input or reference), 404 (missing id), or 409 (delete while books reference the row).
Folder "10. Cleanup" deletes the three rows and folder 11 checks they are gone, so library.db keeps no demo rows.
If a run stopped early, run folder "10. Cleanup" before starting again.

item.name: 1. Health
item.description: Checks the API is running and can read library.db.

item.name: 2. List
item.description: List what is already there. Nothing is written.

item.name: 3. Read one of each
item.description: Read one existing book, author, and publisher. Nothing is written.

item.name: 4. Create
item.description: Create a publisher and an author, then a book pointing at both. Each id is stored in a collection variable.

exec: pm.test("Publisher is Demo Press", () => pm.expect(body.name).to.eql("Demo Press"));
pm.test("Author is Demo Author", () => pm.expect(body).to.include({ name: "Demo", surname: "Author" }));

item.name: 5. Update
item.description: PUT replaces every field, so each request sends all of them.

exec: pm.test("Author is Demo Writer", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({ name: "Demo", surname: "Writer" }));

item.name: 6. Validation errors
item.description: Invalid input is rejected with 400. Nothing is written.

item.name: 7. Not found
item.description: Ids that do not exist give 404. Nothing is written.

item.name: 8. Delete conflict
item.description: The demo book still points at the author and publisher, so deleting them gives 409.

item.name: 9. Pagination
item.description: Use the total to jump to the last page, which holds the newest book (the demo book). Nothing is written.

item.name: 10. Cleanup
item.description: Book first, then author, then publisher. Each returns 204. Run this before another demo if a run stopped early.

item.name: 11. Check deleted
item.description: Check that the book, author, and publisher no longer exist.
